decision.observation: Sunny morning Thu 4, 6:00 am; farmer in the yard south of the house, surrounded by rocks, logs, weeds, and bushes. Axe selected, 405g.
decision.hypothesis: Heading east past the mailbox to the sand path, then north through the pasture gate area, reaches the road to the bus stop and the town plaza for more greetings (7/28).
decision.memory: Day-2 town route: farmyard → east past mailbox → north up sand path → through horseshoe fence bend → road → east past bus stop → plaza. Debris blocks direct paths; axe clears weeds.
